column1: # pk-photo-pages (page-kinds-three), 2026-10-14: the photographed sample, drawn from the owner's archive photos
# (~/Desktop/Google Drive/Archival Photos JPEGS, 100,064 files; seeded draw, one per folder where the form allowed) plus Baker.
# Copies in $STATE/photo-sample/ (third-party, not committed); EXIF-stripped copies of every image in stripped/.
# form: the Finder tag (Clippings, Statistics, Handwritten, Notes), typed = no form tag. kind: photo or scan, by looking; the scans are negatives for the detector.
# truth: a few lines a page (one band, truth_box = x,y,w,h in the stored image's pixels, or the PDF page at 300 dpi; rotation to read it),
# read by eye from full-resolution crops by one reader and again blind by a second (procedure.md v2, steps 2-3 on one band); a word
# where the two differ, or either was unsure, is contested and not scored: 21 of 901. Transcripts in $STATE/photo-sample/truth/ (not committed).
# looks: where the page is not what its form tag says, by the readers' looking. Scan PDFs carry no truth (the bake-off's scans cover them).
